mainText:
Assistance Off · Simulated presentation, not a model call
A month in numbers

Estimate a smaller referral loop. Count gathering, judgement and double-checks; keep pharmacy labour separate from operator hours.

The public referral count defines this manual loop, not all NHSBSA staff work. Edited figures are assumptions.

Assumption default: 70

Assumption default: 5

Assumption default: 6

Whole-service share touched by staff, not the referral-loop denominator.

Difficult-paper keying seconds

Illustrative manual keying time for the difficult paper example.

Assumption default: 30

0 to 86,400

Illustrative human confirmation time, not measured recognition speed.

Assumption default: 10
